summary: Horizon Technology Finance Corp filed an 8-K reporting that its board declared regular monthly cash distributions totaling $0.18 per share and special monthly distributions totaling $0.09 per share, payable in October, November, and December 2026. The special distributions are part of the company's prior intent to distribute spillover income. Total distributions amount to $0.27 per share. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special-situation event. No strategic actions, offers, or structural changes are involved.
